fns.desc: len (unsigned int) = HMAC_MD5_LENGTH + NTLMv2_BLOB_LEN where BLOB_LEN includes ntlm->target_info_len (parsed from server type-2 msg). If target_info_len near UINT_MAX, len wraps small -> calloc small -> memcpy(ptr+44,target_info,target_info_len) heap overflow. Bounded only by upstream type-2 parser; defense-in-depth missing here.
